title: Kühne Logistics University, Hamburg
description: A private university in Hamburg specialising in logistics, supply chain management and business, with English-taught programmes and close industry links.
html:
A specialist university on the harbour

Kühne Logistics University sits in Hamburg's HafenCity, a few hundred metres from one of Europe's largest ports, which is fitting for a university built around logistics and supply chain management. It is private, small, with a few hundred students, and teaches entirely in English. Founded by a logistics entrepreneur's foundation, it combines academic research with unusually close ties to the companies that move goods around the world.

Life beyond lectures

The small size means that students know their professors and each other. The campus organises company visits, guest lectures from industry leaders and a career service that places most graduates within months. Hamburg itself offers a large port economy, media and consulting sectors and a quality of life that regularly ranks among the highest in Germany.

Programmes

A bachelor's in business administration, master's programmes in management, global logistics and supply chain management, and a PhD programme in logistics and management. Tuition applies, with scholarships available for strong applicants.

Preparing your move

As at any German university, non-EU students need a student visa with proof of funds and health insurance. Because the university charges tuition, plan the finances early and set up the Blocked Account and insurance before the embassy appointment.
